### Shared stakes, actual contribution and usable correction

[Ren's instruction to continue](../../../sources/15-codex-theory-conversations/2026-10-06-shared-world-continuation.md) advances the shared-world route in two connected ways: from valuing a supportive world to identifying an effective contribution, and from preserving others' present usefulness to protecting their capacity to correct our own activity. The [argument and review](../../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/SHARED-WORLD-GROUNDING.md#continuation-broad-conditions-and-real-contribution) keep both in the same continuing relations.

Future participation can depend on capacities whose eventual providers, users and failure points are not now identifiable. Where that uncertainty is real, preserving broadly usable conditions can protect warranted possibilities without naming the eventual beneficiary. The relevant good can include the ability to discover needs and revise purposes, rather than fulfilling a fixed list of present preferences. This is conditional on actual exposure, worthwhile possibilities and usable access; merely imaginable futures do not all carry equal practical weight.

A precise sufficient comparison is available. Suppose one arrangement preserves every independently worthwhile continuation supported by another, also preserves additional credibly relevant continuations, and introduces no countervailing difference in cost, authority, protection or other warranted concerns. Those additional possibilities give a reason to favor the first arrangement. Its breadth does not establish the comparison: the actual support and absence of offsetting losses must be shown. This is a limited practical dominance argument under stated value premises, not a new causal theorem, a demand to maximize options, or a rule treating all futures as equally probable. Where the arrangements trade off genuine concerns, it does not decide between them.

But a reason for a supportive arrangement to exist does not establish a reason for every proposed contribution. Assess the actual action against its available alternatives. It might maintain a necessary component, improve reliability, have a credible chance of completing a response, or help form a justified and effective joint provision. If isolated action accomplishes nothing but coordination can succeed, an invitation, agreement or preparation may be the relevant first contribution. Participation in a jointly sufficient scheme can matter even when a simplistic single-action removal test misses its role; that participation and the scheme's legitimacy must be established rather than assumed.

Conversely, if a proposed act changes neither support, reliability, coordination nor any constitutive good, the common-world argument alone has not justified that act. An obligation to contribute a fair share may have another ground; merely receiving a benefit does not establish its full content. Comparing a world where everyone contributes with one where nobody does is not yet a comparison of this person's live options. Shared dependence therefore calls for identifying contributions and their conditions rather than installing collective action by definition.

The second advance concerns independent correction. Where valued future activity depends on information and capabilities distributed among others, preserving their relevant capacity to investigate, report failures and challenge a practice can have practical support through one's own warranted stakes. Such correction must be receivable and able to affect what happens. It may need to change the organizer's purpose, not only improve execution of that purpose. Present obedience and competence can coexist with the destruction of this future capacity.

Consider two conceptual arrangements producing the same useful output now. One filters out evidence that challenges its controlling purpose. The other preserves competent inquiry and a usable route for warranted challenge to change that purpose. Where the second preserves warranted future possibilities that the first forecloses, without defeating the relevant safeguards, concern for the shared world favors that corrective capacity. This is a conditional comparison, not an empirical claim that all dissent helps or every restriction harms. Functional independence relevant to correction does not by itself establish unrestricted authority, equal standing or every dimension of personal autonomy.

The existing [selection account](GENERATIVE-SELECTION.md#3-selection-over-the-network-of-correctors) identifies supporting mechanisms: actual independence depends on access and support; competence can erode despite improved current performance; nominal alternatives may lack a route into use. Its distinct conditional laws are not one newly demonstrated history. The older [consequence-selection result](../../../_process/research/2026-10-05-support-and-shared-generativity/completion/CONSEQUENCE-RETENTION-SELECTION.md) also separates useful contribution from sufficient support for its producer to continue contributing. These mechanisms constrain how justified concern can become effective; they do not supply its ethical validity.

The resulting principle is: **where warranted continuation depends on broadly usable and revisable shared capacities, an effective, legitimate contribution to those capacities can be justified before a particular future return is known.** This includes protecting capacities through which others can change what we recognize as worth pursuing. Free riding tests the contribution relation; insulation tests exposure; captured gains and incompatible futures test priority and the content of the valued continuation. The next connection is to identify and compare actual contributions and corrective capacities, with their support, permissions and effects preserved. Universal contribution, equal burdens and inevitable cooperation remain unproved.

## Continuation: broad conditions and real contribution

[Ren's continuation request](../../../../sources/15-codex-theory-conversations/2026-10-06-shared-world-continuation.md) prompts a specific extension of the prior argument. The [canonical section](../../../../theories/shengsheng-buxi-generative-existence/unified-2026-10-05/UNIFIED-ETHICAL-GROUNDING.md#shared-stakes-actual-contribution-and-usable-correction) now connects warranted future stakes, broader supporting conditions, effective participation and independent correction.

The sufficient comparison keeps its value premises explicit. A broader arrangement has an advantage if it preserves all independently worthwhile continuations supported by the narrower arrangement, adds credibly relevant ones, and has no countervailing difference across the warranted concerns being compared. This is practical dominance at that declared scope. It supplies no universal scalar, equal-position lottery, maximin rule or claim that every additional option is good. Maintenance costs, authority, safeguards, access and external effects belong inside the comparison.

The contribution test corrects a possible overreach in the prior route. A participant's reason for shared support to exist is not already a reason for every token contribution. The act must actually sustain, restore, improve reliability, open credible coordination or constitute a warranted good. A jointly effective provision can matter without each contribution being uniquely pivotal; its legitimate organization and actual participation require identification. Where neither direct action nor coordination changes the relevant conditions, this causal route supplies no new justification for that act. Fairness, promises and other responsibilities may supply distinct grounds. Contrasting universal cooperation with universal defection does not establish an individual-action comparison.

The new positive ground for independent agency is equally concrete. Warranted future participation may depend on relevant information or capabilities dispersed among others. If usable independent inquiry and challenge preserve that continuation, an effective contribution to those capacities gains derivative practical significance. The correction can change current purposes, not only means. This differs from maintaining competent obedience. It is conditional on relevant independence and legitimate channels actually making warranted correction possible; it does not derive all political freedom, equal standing or unconditional authority from usefulness.

Three collaborating agents supplied the affirmative argument, adversarial review and existing-results audit. They converged on this positive scope while retaining free riding, insulation and domination as different tests. The first concerns an action's contribution, the second the reach of shared exposure, and the third conflicts among gains, control and dimensions of wellbeing. They are not interchangeable refutations of every shared-world reason. A participant can have a protective reason while incentives or competing advantages defeat its implementation.

The source audit read the complete consequence-selection note and shared-world note, the governing method, selection §§1–6 and selected market/renewal results. The integrator directly read selection §§3–6 and the prior shared-world argument. Existing source evidence is reused, not counted as fresh corroboration. [Selection and correction](../../../../theories/shengsheng-buxi-generative-existence/unified-2026-10-05/GENERATIVE-SELECTION.md#3-selection-over-the-network-of-correctors) identifies access, support, competence and usable alternatives. [Consequence and retention](../../2026-10-05-support-and-shared-generativity/completion/CONSEQUENCE-RETENTION-SELECTION.md) separates usefulness from retained advantage. No new theorem, experiment, empirical finding or material join is claimed.

This advances the named bridge to actual contribution and revisable shared capacities. The earlier direct-relief necessity dispute is not a prerequisite for investigating it. The stronger universal ethics objective remains active; neither the actor's own stakes nor effective contribution establishes the standing of every insulated or powerless being. The next study should identify an actual dependency, a feasible contribution or coordination, and a correction channel that can affect the continuing activity, comparing its failures without erasing costs or interests.

The [additive receipt](SHARED-WORLD-CONTINUATION-EDITS.json), [snapshot metadata](development/SHARED-WORLD-CONTINUATION-BEFORE.json) and [file/link checks](SHARED-WORLD-CONTINUATION-CHECKS.json) record this continuation independently of scientific validation. Earlier shared-world text and concurrent canonical additions remain preserved.

**Shared stakes → effective contribution and usable correction, 6 October 2026:** [the continuation](theories/shengsheng-buxi-generative-existence/unified-2026-10-05/UNIFIED-ETHICAL-GROUNDING.md#shared-stakes-actual-contribution-and-usable-correction) develops a conditional reason for broadly accessible support under actual future uncertainty, then distinguishes a valuable arrangement from one's effective contribution. It also grounds support for relevant independent inquiry and challenge where they sustain warranted continuation, including revision of purposes. [Argument and review](_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/SHARED-WORLD-GROUNDING.md#continuation-broad-conditions-and-real-contribution) retain free riding, insulation, capture and genuine tradeoffs; no universal contribution rule, empirical result or favorable-selection theorem is claimed. Next identify actual contribution and correction channels within the same supported history.

**Contributing to a revisable shared world, 6 October 2026:** [the ethical continuation](unified-2026-10-05/UNIFIED-ETHICAL-GROUNDING.md#shared-stakes-actual-contribution-and-usable-correction) connects future participation to broadly usable support, effective contribution and others' capacity to correct shared purposes. The argument preserves the distinction between wanting a condition to exist and justifying a particular act. [Review](../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/SHARED-WORLD-GROUNDING.md#continuation-broad-conditions-and-real-contribution) keeps conditional scope, competing concerns and the stronger universal objective explicit.

edits.addition: **Shared future stakes → contribution and correction, 6 October 2026.** The [new connection](UNIFIED-ETHICAL-GROUNDING.md#shared-stakes-actual-contribution-and-usable-correction) gives a conditional practical comparison for broader support and requires an actual contribution or legitimate coordinated provision. Warranted continuation can also support others' relevant independence where inquiry and challenge enable correction of shared activity and its purposes. Existing correction/retention laws constrain implementation without deriving ethical validity. Next identify these dependencies and usable contributions, retaining intermediate conditions, legitimacy and conflicts; no universal contribution or equal-standing theorem is added.

**Shared-world continuation, 6 October 2026:** [the added argument and review](SHARED-WORLD-GROUNDING.md#continuation-broad-conditions-and-real-contribution) distinguish valuable shared conditions, effective contribution and usable independent correction. A limited comparison supports broader capacities only with independently warranted possibilities and no countervailing difference. [Exact additions](SHARED-WORLD-CONTINUATION-EDITS.json) and [checks](SHARED-WORLD-CONTINUATION-CHECKS.json) preserve the continuation without new scientific claims.

**Shared-world continuation, 6 October 2026:** [Ren's instruction to continue](15-codex-theory-conversations/2026-10-06-shared-world-continuation.md) follows the shared-world grounding correction. The [development](../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/SHARED-WORLD-GROUNDING.md#continuation-broad-conditions-and-real-contribution) is AI-authored argument and internal review, distinguished from his exact words and from new empirical evidence.
